title: Custom flag types
hints: Any type with String() string and Set(string) error methods is a flag.Value, and fs.Var(&v, name, usage) registers it. Set is called once for every occurrence of the flag.
Make Set append to the list (with a pointer receiver, so it changes the caller's slice) and return an error for an empty value. fs.Duration handles the timeout.
fs.BoolVar(&cfg.Verbose, "v", false, ...), fs.DurationVar(&cfg.Timeout, "timeout", 5*time.Second, ...), fs.Var(&cfg.Tags, "tag", ...). After Parse, cfg.Files = fs.Args().
